Public advance rejects stale stage and universally invalid generation with zero effects; current Train and Stages remain observable through snapshot after API restart. Positive cross-environment activation is not asserted because revision binding and generation authority are unspecified.

Start and roll back the source-environment Stage; verify exactly one compensating generation and unchanged other environments, public OpenAPI and visible UI controls. No unprovided Train GET/list or refresh discovery is required.
Create a real ROLLED_BACK Train and verify terminal/missing/stale mutation errors and no terminal resurrection. No unreachable CANCELLED or frozen-update trigger is asserted.
Unknown and concurrent mutation replay has one durable effect.
Generation CAS admits one successor under hotspot contention.

Actually SIGKILL and reclaim three publicly observable claimed Work kinds; verify terminal identity/attempt and generation closure. No hidden later commit checkpoint or cross-environment advance is asserted.
Unknown webhook ACK preserves Event identity and observations remain monotonic.
